cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(XLICUDataTools LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
file(TO_CMAKE_PATH "${XL_ICU_SOURCE}" XL_ICU_SOURCE)
file(TO_CMAKE_PATH "${XL_ICU_PREFIX}" XL_ICU_PREFIX)
find_library(XL_ICUI18N NAMES icui18n PATHS "${XL_ICU_PREFIX}/lib" NO_DEFAULT_PATH REQUIRED)
find_library(XL_ICUUC NAMES icuuc PATHS "${XL_ICU_PREFIX}/lib" NO_DEFAULT_PATH REQUIRED)
set(ICU_SOURCE "${XL_ICU_SOURCE}/source")
function(icu_sources output directory)
  file(STRINGS "${ICU_SOURCE}/tools/${directory}/sources.txt" names REGEX "^[a-zA-Z0-9_].*\\.(c|cpp)$")
  set(result)
  foreach(name IN LISTS names)
    list(APPEND result "${ICU_SOURCE}/tools/${directory}/${name}")
  endforeach()
  set(${output} ${result} PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()
icu_sources(TOOLUTIL_SOURCES toolutil)
add_library(icu_toolutil STATIC ${TOOLUTIL_SOURCES})
target_compile_definitions(icu_toolutil PUBLIC U_STATIC_IMPLEMENTATION U_LIB_SUFFIX_C_NAME=_xl
  PRIVATE U_TOOLUTIL_IMPLEMENTATION)
target_include_directories(icu_toolutil PUBLIC "${ICU_SOURCE}/common" "${ICU_SOURCE}/i18n" "${ICU_SOURCE}/tools/toolutil")
target_link_libraries(icu_toolutil PUBLIC ${XL_ICUI18N} ${XL_ICUUC} Threads::Threads)
if(WIN32)
  target_link_libraries(icu_toolutil PUBLIC advapi32)
endif()
add_library(icu_tool_entry OBJECT tool_entry.cpp)
target_link_libraries(icu_tool_entry PRIVATE icu_toolutil)
foreach(tool IN ITEMS gencnval gencfu makeconv genbrk gensprep gendict icupkg genrb)
  icu_sources(TOOL_SOURCES ${tool})
  add_executable(${tool} ${TOOL_SOURCES} $<TARGET_OBJECTS:icu_tool_entry>)
  target_compile_definitions(${tool} PRIVATE main=xl_icu_data_tool_main)
  if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(${tool} PRIVATE "/FI${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tool_main.h")
  else()
    target_compile_options(${tool} PRIVATE -include "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tool_main.h")
  endif()
  target_link_libraries(${tool} PRIVATE icu_toolutil)
  set_target_properties(${tool} PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin")
endforeach()
